stage_name_zh: 阶段 2：准确表达、一词多义辨析与时序/AI 基础句法（Day 26–50）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G008】语序、否定辖域、部分否定与句首否定倒装；【G013】近义词与多义词深度辨析：语义范围、褒贬色彩、技术定义与语域。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP019】机器学习与时间序列：问题定义、滞后项与符号约定，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 语序、否定辖域、部分否定与句首否定倒装
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 精确控制否定与限定副词（only, solely, merely, by no means, under no circumstances, rarely, seldom）的辖域。当否定或唯一下界短语置于句首时，主句必须采用部分倒装。
rules: 区分全部否定（none of, in no way, under no circumstances, by no means）与部分否定（not all, not necessarily, not always）。
当 by no means, in no way, under no circumstances, in no circumstances, on no account, rarely, seldom, only when... 置于句首时，主句必须部分倒装（助动词/be/情态动词提至主语前）。
间接疑问从句（assess to what extent the results depend on...）一律保持陈述语序，不倒装。
examples: By no means is the result certain. (对比句中：A large sample is by no means sufficient to eliminate systematic bias.)
Under no circumstances should test labels be used for model tuning.
Only when the protocol was approved did recruitment begin.
common_errors: 句首否定强调漏掉倒装：*Under no circumstances test labels should be used。
间接疑问句误用倒装：*examine how does the system behave（应为 how the system behaves）。

grammar_instruction.name: 近义词与多义词深度辨析：语义范围、褒贬色彩、技术定义与语域
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 区分近义词与一词多义在语义范围、判断强度、褒贬色彩及学科专有定义上的差别。禁止把仅有部分重合的词当作完全同义词替换，禁止为堆砌大词而改变事实或判断强度。
rules: 测量与统计核心辨析：accuracy（准确度，接近真值） vs precision（精密度，重复测量一致）；reliable（稳定一致） vs valid（有效测量目标构念或推理成立）；efficacy（受控试验效力） vs effectiveness（真实场景效果）；equal（均等） vs equitable（按需求公平分配）；seasonality（固定日历周期） vs cyclicality（非固定周期的波动）；isotonic（保序的/等渗的） vs isotropic（各向同性的）。
褒贬与语域辨析：simple（简明清晰的） vs simplistic（过度简化的，贬义）；exploit structure（中性：利用结构） vs exploit workers（贬义：剥削）；manipulate a variable（中性：实验操纵自变量） vs falsify data（贬义：伪造数据）。
examples: An equitable allocation of resources may differ from an equal allocation.
Business cyclicality may involve expansions and contractions of varying duration, whereas seasonality follows a fixed calendar period.
An isotropic covariance function depends on distance rather than direction, whereas isotonic regression enforces a monotonicity constraint.
common_errors: 把 suggest/indicate 机械替换为 prove/demonstrate 导致过度推断。
混淆形近学术词：adapt/adopt, adverse/averse, discrete/discreet, temporal/temporary, stationary/stationery, isotonic/isotropic。

grammar_instruction.name: 句子改写核心规范：语义等价、限定守恒与消除四大改写偏差
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 句子改写必须在改变句法或词汇结构的同时，100% 保持原句的事实范围、否定、时间、程度和认知确定性，并能准确诊断语法错误、表达不自然、语域不当与语义扭曲。
rules: 限定守恒：原句的 provided that, in this sample, under Gaussian-kernel assumptions, may, arguably 等在改写后必须保留等价限定。
多路径自然改写：支持动词 <-> 派生名词转换、从句 <-> 介词短语转换、主动 <-> 被动焦点转换，提供多个自然可接受版本。
examples:
Source: Missing records account for the discrepancy between the totals.
Rewrite 1: The discrepancy between the totals is attributable to missing records.
Rewrite 2: Missing records explain why the two totals differ.
common_errors: 在改写中偷换概念或将相关关系升级为因果结论。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 机器学习与时间序列：问题定义、滞后项与符号约定

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：形容词，修饰 release 等名词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The report examined an accidental release of coolant.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00049 n.] 准确度（例：The team evaluated measurement accuracy.）；[V00050 n.] 准确性（例：Reference measurements were used to assess accuracy.） | 本条用法约束：教材词缀例词单列；例句为原创假设情境。词缀对应关系与拼写见同单元说明。
一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00049 n.] 准确度（例：The team evaluated measurement accuracy.）；[V00050 n.] 准确性（例：Reference measurements were used to assess accuracy.） | 本条用法约束：accuracy 不能仅由重复读数接近来保证。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Reference measurements were used to assess accuracy.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：动词 achieve；不是所有 participation 都代表 achievement。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The report distinguishes academic achievement from attendance.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：acquire的名词形式。
学术语境与搭配约束：adjust的名词形式。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The staff made adjustments to the timetable.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：动词adopt；本例为采用，不是收养义。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The adoption of a shared code helps keep labels consistent.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：教材词缀例词单列；例句为原创假设情境。词缀对应关系与拼写见同单元说明。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The study examines the transition to adulthood.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：来自 alter；改变对象常接 to。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: An alteration to the questionnaire reduced its length.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：单数 analysis；复数 analyses。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The appendix provides an analysis of missing data.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：保留不确定性，不等于 definitely。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The records were apparently inconsistent until the coding rules were compared.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：动词appear；此例是外观义，抽象appearance也可表示出现。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The appearance of the symbol varies with the typeface.
